text:
emma: Quick pre-merge check for 0.9.2 — need a fast green sweep, changelog bump, and any urgent PR calls. Who can own build verification?

li: I can run a focused green-sweep across feature/* and release/0.9.x branches. Will call out failures as I see them.

ci-bot: Started pipeline: release-0.9.2/smoke (jobs: build, unit, e2e). ETA ~12m.

jamie: FYI windows-build is flaky on serializer tests (AttachmentSerializerSpec). Trying to reproduce locally.

emma: If windows is the only blocker we can consider merging without that matrix and backfilling, but let's try to avoid that. Prioritize a quick triage.

li: Found 2 flaky unit tests in auth package that fail intermittently. Rerunning failed jobs now with --rerun-failed. Command I used:
```
pytest tests/auth -k "not flaky_mark" -q
```

ops-oncall: Noticing elevated runner queue latency in us-west-2, e2e jobs might be delayed ~5-10m. Keeping an eye.

jamie: Reproduced the windows failure locally — it's a race around temporary file cleanup. Pushing a tiny test-guard + fix as a PR  in 10m.

emma: Changelog note: please add `fix: windows serializer race` and bump package version to 0.9.2 in package.json. Remember the release-notes checklist (compatibility, migration notes). Link: https://internal/release/runbook/0.9.2

li: CI green after reruns + jamie's fix. Two unit flake reruns cleared, e2e passed on rerun.

jamie: PR #4821 containing the fix + test guard is up. Small diff, CI green on branch.

emma: Thanks. Can someone merge changelog + version bump? I'll tag and trigger the release pipeline after merge.

li: Merged changelog PR and bumped version. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Acknowledge. Will trigger release pipeline when tag v0.9.2 is created.

emma: Creating tag v0.9.2 now, then handoff to ops for rollout. :shipit:

ops-oncall: Noted — monitoring post-deploy metrics and will escalate if latency spikes.

emma: Thanks everyone — overall quick turn. If any remaining flakies show up post-rollout, ping this thread and we'll open a follow-up patch.
